It transforms the pipeline into a heavy, raymarched, rasterized ordeal—requiring bounding volumes, step-size marching grids, and pixel-level sampling to capture the error accumulation.

Instead of calculating where the error fluidly deforms the mesh, the 1-bit timeline treats the 3-loop trefoil knot like a mechanical pinion gear.

By throwing away the 4th-order remainder as an irrelevant spatial artifact, the entire topological engine stays boundlessly scalable, packed cleanly as a sequence of boolean states without ever needing to spawn a coordinate plane.
